decisions: The context is defined in shared/providers, not features/workspace, because a feature may not import another feature (I3) and src/app may not read the store (I4); this is the seam the remaining mounts need (the review's recommended resolution 1).
The workspace shell provides profileId/sessionId from values it already resolves, so the context adds no second source for them (one home per fact).
The note panel lists the session's highlights instead of making highlight marks clickable: listening marks would fight z1 text selection (010 chose listening:false for that reason).
use-highlights-for-session filters the table because highlights has no plain artifactId index (db/migrations.ts); a workspace's highlight set is small, and this avoids a schema bump.
The panel picks the caller's own note first (that is what the editor writes) and falls back to a teammate's on a group highlight.
012/015 remain open only for hardware/live goals; 026 consumes their built components without depending on or closing those goals (analyze.json open_questions).
